//: Generic: no app or location is named here. An app is a folder memory/features/<app>/.
Its feature catalog is <features>, and its online source is the .env variable <env>
(<APP> = the folder name upper-cased, dashes as underscores), e.g.
The kind of source is recognised from that value by each kind's `match`. The memory agent
(.claude/agents/memory.md) lists and reads it with the tools named for its kind, diffs it with
`node pipeline/memory.mjs diff <app> <listing.json>`, and merges what changed into the catalog
Remote files modified on or before the catalog's `generated` date are its baseline: already in
the catalog, so they are recorded, not read.
indexOnly: titles that are tracked but never read into features (digests covering many at once).

google-drive-folder.list: mcp__claude_ai_Google_Drive__search_files with query parentId = '<id>' and excludeContentSnippets true; follow every nextPageToken
